title: 電動ヘッジトリマー
description: 庭園や生垣の管理場面に使う横置きのヘッジトリマー。重ねた対向刃と保持バー、先端保護部、手元ガード、前後二つの開口ハンドル、トリガー、通気ルーバー付きの無銘モーター外装を備えます。電池・電源コード・植物・内部駆動部は付属せず、刈込み動作・性能・安全認証はありません。 ゲーム・可視化向け。製造・構造設計・3Dプリント用途は未検証。 外接寸法（X×Y×Z）1.186 × 0.243 × 0.256 m、16,640三角形。単位m・Y-up、水平中央の接地用原点、最下点Y=0。部品ごとの重複UV0と単色PBR材質を収録し、画像テクスチャ・UV2・コライダー・LOD・リグ・動作は付属しません。静的表示用でUnity/VRChat実機検証は未実施。STLはm・Y-up座標の形状のみで色・材質・UV・階層を含みません。
descriptionEn: A horizontally resting hedge trimmer for garden and hedge-maintenance scenes, with layered opposed toothed cutters and retaining bar, tip protector, hand guard, two open handles, trigger and an unbranded louvered motor housing. Battery, power cord, plants and working internals are omitted; no cutting behavior, performance or safety certification is supplied. For games and visualization; not validated for manufacture, structural engineering or 3D printing. Bounding dimensions (X×Y×Z): 1.186 × 0.243 × 0.256 m; 16,640 triangles. Metres, Y-up, horizontally centered placement origin with minimum Y=0, not an articulation or wall-mount pivot. Includes overlapping component UV0 and constant-color PBR materials, with no image textures, unique UV2, colliders, LOD, rig or runtime behavior. Static visualization only; Unity/VRChat editor and runtime tests have not been performed. STL uses metre-valued Y-up coordinates and contains geometry only, without color, materials, UVs or hierarchy.
author: Xenoah
uv: Per-component primitive or automatically unwrapped UVs. Overlapping between components; not a packed unique lightmap atlas. Solid-color PBR materials; no external textures. STL has no colors or UVs.
